summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC (issuer) furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release from Jaguar Uranium Corp. regarding an exploration program at the Huemul Project in Argentina. The filing also references a previously disclosed Share Exchange Agreement with shareholders of Royal Uranium Inc. to acquire up to 100% of Royal Uranium's shares, subject to closing conditions. The press release contains forward-looking statements about Jaguar's exploration activities including a pending rock sampling assay and a potential 4km copper trend. The acquisition of Royal Uranium is not yet closed and no specific terms (price, premium, timeline) are stated. This is a routine foreign private issuer update with no definitive special-situation event triggering classification.
